quotes.text: Do not ask Intune to remember, reconcile, and repair without Azure at its side. Intune declares, Azure enforces, the graph binds, managed identity limits, log analytics witnesses, and your realm moves from managed to self-healing.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarises the division of labour between Intune and Azure services in one line.

quotes.text: Scale happens not with more hands, but with fewer keys. A runbook that disables devices after 60 days of silence does more for truth than a weekly export ever will.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete argument for automation over manual exports at scale.

quotes.text: No stored keys. No recycled client secrets. No forgotten app registrations with broad reach. The identity lives with the workload. Dies with the workload. And holds only the power carved into its role.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains clearly why managed identities beat stored secrets.

quotes.text: Where automation rings the bell at set hours, functions, answer the knock on the door. A web hook arrives when a device enrolls. A lightweight function inspects the device properties.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Vivid distinction between scheduled automation and event-driven functions.

quotes.text: Replace every secret with a managed identity, if an application identity is required bind it to key vault with role-based access and rotation, never bake credentials into code.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear, actionable security recommendation for automation scripts.

Combining Intune with Azure Automation, managed identities and Functions

takeaways: Intune declares policy, but at tens of thousands of endpoints it needs Azure Automation and Functions to reconcile drift, clean up stale devices and repair posture.
Managed identities with narrow Graph permissions, PIM and least privilege replace stored secrets and standing global admin rights.
Log Analytics and KQL turn device management into measurable metrics such as drift variance, cleanup rate and mean time to remediate.
hook: Intune alone cannot keep thousands of endpoints honest: drift, ghost devices and overpowered admins pile up. This episode shows endpoint and identity admins how to combine Intune with Azure Automation, Functions, managed identities, Graph and Log Analytics into a self-healing, least-privilege device platform.
